description: CKMA formalization of selected GAPS.md entries, with public declaration inventory, concrete definitions, admitted theorem targets, completed proofs and explicit partial scopes.

status_meanings.not_started: No formalized statement or supporting definitions yet.
status_meanings.statement: The listed theorem targets express the entry in the documented scope; proofs may be admitted.
status_meanings.partial: The exact implemented part is documented; the rest of the entry is not represented.
status_meanings.proved: All selected assertions of this entry are proved without sorryAx, subject to an axiom audit.

entries.title: Baire classification of derivatives
entries.scope: Open subsets of the real line, including disconnected sets and the empty set.

entries.title: Denjoy–Young–Saks theorem
entries.scope: All finite real functions, with no measurability assumption, and exactly one of four extended Dini types almost everywhere. Left limits use negative increments in the same difference quotient.

entries.title: Approximate continuity
entries.scope: Finite measurable real functions on a second-countable Borel space, for a locally finite uniformly locally doubling measure, are approximately continuous almost everywhere. Euclidean volume is included.

entries.title: Rectangular differentiation
entries.scope: Open axis-aligned rectangles with no eccentricity bound, local L(log+ L)^(d-1) differentiation and endpoint maximal inequality, and L1 failure in dimensions at least two. Positive integrals and maximal values retain infinity.

entries.title: Kirszbraun's theorem
entries.scope: Exact Lipschitz constant on arbitrary subsets of a real inner-product domain into a complete real Hilbert target; empty subsets and zero constants are included.

entries.title: Kolmogorov three-series theorem
entries.scope: Ordinary sequence-order convergence, not unconditional Summable, for the random series and the truncated mean series; variances and probability tails have nonnegative summability.

entries.title: Hartman–Wintner iterated-logarithm law
entries.scope: IID centered real variables of strictly positive finite variance; extended-real limsup/liminf and an index shift avoid small logarithm exceptions.

entries.title: Lindeberg–Feller theorem
entries.scope: Independent centered rows of square-integrable real variables with positive row variances. Feller infinitesimality is imposed only for the reverse implication.

entries.title: Berry–Esseen bound
entries.scope: Kolmogorov distance of laws, positive variance and finite absolute third moment; explicit nonoptimal universal constant 100.

entries.title: Lévy–Khintchine formula
entries.scope: Probability convolution roots and actual Levy triplets with no atom at zero. The compensated exponent uses truncation x*1_{|x|<=1}, which fixes uniqueness.

entries.title: Cramér's theorem
entries.scope: Reuses the existing LDP predicates at speed n+1; the rate is the Legendre transform of the extended-log MGF, retaining infinite exponential moments.

entries.title: Sanov's theorem
entries.scope: Polish state spaces, weak topology on ProbabilityMeasure, TauCeti finite empirical probabilities, and Mathlib relative entropy.

entries.title: Varadhan's integral lemma
entries.scope: Full open-lower/closed-upper LDP at speed n+1 and bounded continuous test functions, without goodness of the rate. Zero probabilities and infinite rates use extended logarithms and suprema.

entries.title: Equivalent sub-Gaussian descriptions
entries.scope: Concrete extended gauge and quantitative scale implications; the MGF-to-gauge adapter and the exact infimum-gauge equivalence remain.

entries.title: Gaussian logarithmic Sobolev inequality
entries.scope: Smooth real functions in Gaussian L2 on arbitrary finite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces; normalized KL-integrand entropy retains infinite entropy and has the exact factor two.

entries.title: Symmetrization
entries.scope: Nonempty countable function classes with a measurable integrable envelope; signs on an independent product factor. The general measurable-supremum formulation remains.

entries.title: Hanson–Wright inequality
entries.scope: A constant uniform over dimensions, probability spaces, coordinate laws and real matrices; concrete Euclidean operator and Frobenius norms. No symmetry restriction on the real matrix is needed.

entries.title: Johnson–Lindenstrauss lemma
entries.scope: Uses log(2 max(N,1)) to include the empty configuration.

entries.title: Brownian construction and continuous modification
entries.scope: Canonical probability law on the Borel space of continuous real paths; continuous modifications of pre-Brownian processes on their original probability space and every positive local Holder exponent below one half.

entries.title: Strong Markov property
entries.scope: Finite-valued stopping times for the raw natural filtration; the post-stopping process is Brownian and finite-dimensional events are independent of Mathlib's stopping-time sigma-algebra. The completed right-continuous augmented-filtration interface remains.

entries.title: Reflection principle
entries.scope: Strictly positive barrier, nonnegative observation time including zero, and a path-supremum event expressed by existence of a hitting time.

entries.title: Quadratic variation
entries.scope: Completed-interval sums: scalar UCP and summable-mesh a.s. convergence, and independent-coordinate UCP covariation. The a.s. cross-coordinate statement and a bundled bracket process remain.

entries.title: Existence and pathwise uniqueness for Lipschitz coefficients
Smooth-density criterion and integration by parts
Young's integration theorem
entries.scope: Operator-valued integrands and Banach-valued integrators/outputs on a finite interval; Holder and complementary finite p,q variation criteria, all-partition convergence and remainder estimates. The sewing primitive is normalized and defined only on its interval.

entries.title: Sewing lemma
entries.scope: Continuous increment fields with diagonal zero and defect exponent greater than one; a unique normalized continuous interval primitive and convergence along arbitrary ordered partitions, including degenerate intervals.

entries.title: Birkhoff pointwise theorem
entries.scope: Arbitrary probability-preserving measurable systems and integrable real observables; finite maximal ergodic inequality, a.e. invariant-conditional-expectation limit, and ergodic scalar-mean limit. No standard-Borel restriction is needed here.

entries.title: Kingman's subadditive theorem
entries.scope: Integrable positive-length subadditive real processes with a uniform lower bound on mean rates; invariant integrable limit, a.e. and L1 convergence, expectation-infimum formula, and ergodic constant limit.

entries.title: Rokhlin tower lemma
entries.scope: Positive finite heights in an aperiodic standard-Borel probability system, with a bimeasurable measure-preserving automorphism; pairwise disjoint image levels and near-full union mass.

entries.title: Furstenberg multiple recurrence
entries.scope: Positive-liminf arithmetic-progression recurrence at lengths k>=2, the selected nontrivial gap beyond k=1.

entries.title: Newton and Maclaurin inequalities
entries.scope: Nonnegative finite tuples, normalized Mathlib multiset elementary symmetric polynomials, Newton log-concavity and the full Maclaurin root chain.

entries.title: Discrete Hardy inequality
entries.scope: Extended nonnegative sums for arbitrary nonnegative sequences; sharpness already on finitely supported inputs, for every real exponent p>1.

entries.title: Hilbert's integral inequality
entries.scope: Integral and discrete upper bounds with the sharp proposed constant; the optimality assertions remain unstated.

entries.title: Carleman's inequality
entries.scope: Nonnegative summable sequences; the constant e is optimal already for finitely supported sequences.

entries.title: Choquet representation
entries.scope: Compact metrizable convex subsets of locally convex Hausdorff real spaces; probability on the subset, carried by its extreme points, tested by continuous affine maps.

entries.title: Subdifferential sum rule
entries.scope: Banach sum rule under a common finite-domain continuity qualification; the finite-dimensional relative-interior alternative is not stated.

entries.title: Everywhere-defined proximal mapping
entries.scope: Proper lower semicontinuous convex extended-real functions on real Hilbert spaces: proximal existence and uniqueness, subdifferential characterization, firm nonexpansiveness and a guarded totalized proximal map.

entries.title: Fenchel–Rockafellar duality
entries.scope: Proper lower-semicontinuous convex Banach-space functions, a common finite continuity point, finite primal value; equality and dual attainment, without primal attainment.

entries.title: Slater and KKT conditions
entries.scope: Finite-dimensional Slater/KKT necessity, and proved sufficiency in arbitrary real normed spaces; explicit subgradient and complementary-slackness data, including empty finite constraint lists.

entries.title: Ekeland variational principle
entries.scope: Extended-real proper l.s.c. bounded-below functions on complete metric spaces; positive error epsilon and distance scale, finite initial value. Epsilon positivity is essential for the strict variational inequality.

entries.title: Clarke gradient representation
entries.scope: Joint basepoint/positive-step extended directional limsup, dual-valued generalized gradients, and derivative limits. The closed-convex-hull representation assumes finite dimension and local Lipschitz control. The support identity holds for a locally Lipschitz function on any real normed space.

entries.title: Cauchy interlacing
entries.scope: Real or complex finite-dimensional Hilbert endomorphisms. Compression is supplied by a linear isometry; symmetry of the compression is derived internally.

entries.title: Weyl inequalities
entries.scope: Real or complex Hermitian endomorphisms with zero-based sorted indices. Symmetry of the sum follows from the two summands.

entries.title: Hoffman–Wielandt inequality
entries.scope: Real or complex operators with supplied orthonormal eigenbases; unconditional normal eigenbasis existence is a complex-space fact supplied by TauCeti.

entries.title: Nash inequality
entries.scope: Real scalar L1 ∩ H1 with a supplied weak Frechet derivative; positive dimension.

entries.title: Eberlein–Šmulian theorem
entries.scope: Real or complex Banach spaces; relative compactness is closure-compactness in the actual weak topology, and subsequence limits are allowed in the ambient space.

entries.title: James compactness theorem, sufficiency
entries.scope: Real Banach spaces: a norm-closed convex set is weakly compact when every continuous linear functional attains its supremum. Attainment supplies nonemptiness and boundedness.

entries.title: Uniform convexity of $L^p$ away from the Hilbert case
entries.scope: Mathlib UniformConvexSpace for scalar Lp over any measure, real or complex scalars, 1<p<infinity. The Hilbert exponent is included in the general interface.

entries.title: Bipolar theorem for dual pairs
entries.scope: In fact no separating hypothesis is needed when the closure is explicitly in WeakBilin B.

entries.title: Rosenthal $\ell^1$ theorem
entries.scope: Real Banach spaces; weak Cauchy subsequence versus a subsequence satisfying two-sided l1 finite-coefficient estimates. The complex-scalar version and a bundled Schauder-span equivalence remain.

entries.title: Dunford–Pettis compactness in $L^1$
entries.scope: Finite measure spaces and real/complex scalar L1; reuses Mathlib UniformIntegrable, whose predicate already includes uniform L1 boundedness.

entries.title: Kwapień theorem
entries.scope: Real Banach spaces, actual isomorphism to a bundled complete real Hilbert space, and uniform finite Rademacher second-moment type/cotype constants. The complex version remains.

entries.title: Dvoretzky theorem
entries.scope: Real infinite-dimensional Banach spaces; scaled embeddings of every finite Euclidean space with distortion at most 1+epsilon. The complex version and an explicit Banach-Mazur-distance declaration remain.

entries.title: Superreflexive renorming theorem
entries.scope: Real Banach spaces; finite representability is concrete via almost-isometric finite-dimensional embeddings, reflexivity uses the canonical bidual map, and renormings are actual Seminorm objects with positive two-sided comparison and explicit convexity/smoothness inequalities. Bundled normed-space instances and complex analogues remain.

entries.title: Pietsch domination theorem
entries.scope: Real operators and every finite p>=1; exact-constant domination by an inner-regular Borel probability on the actual weak-star dual unit ball. Reuses TauCeti summingENorm, including its infimal constant, rather than defining another summing gauge. The complex version remains.

entries.title: Grothendieck inequality
entries.scope: The real scalar-field inequality with a universal constant, finite matrices, and finite-dimensional Euclidean vectors; arbitrary finite Hilbert families reduce to their span. The complex scalar version remains.

entries.title: Operator-valued Mihlin theorem on the line
Band projections
entries.scope: An algebraic real Riesz space with Dedekind completeness on the chosen order; range, disjoint-complement kernel, idempotence, positivity, domination by identity, and positive-vector supremum characterization.

entries.title: Freudenthal spectral theorem
entries.scope: Explicit Archimedean Riesz property and principal positive band projections; order-error approximation by finite disjoint components of a positive element, with a concrete principal ideal and order-unit gauge. The gauge API and an abstract order-unit normed-space packaging remain.

entries.title: Riesz–Kantorovich theorem
entries.scope: Order-bounded equals regular into a Dedekind-complete real Riesz space, plus binary supremum and its Riesz-Kantorovich formula. The easy regular-to-order-bounded implication is proved separately. Bundling the full Dedekind-complete operator lattice and the operator-modulus formula remain.

entries.title: Kakutani representation of AM spaces with unit
entries.scope: AM Banach lattice with a unit represented by a lattice isometric linear equivalence to real C(K), taking the unit to one; K may be empty for the zero space. The C(K)-is-AM converse is not yet separately stated.

entries.title: Kakutani representation of AL spaces
entries.scope: Real AL Banach lattice representation as a lattice-isometric L1 space and the KB consequence. The representing measure is not restricted to sigma-finite measures. Full net-based order continuity remains.

entries.title: Gleason–Kahane–Żelazko theorem
entries.scope: Unital complex Banach algebras; algebraic normalized functional, no continuity or commutativity assumed.

entries.title: Shilov boundary theorem
entries.scope: Closed point-separating subalgebra of C(K), compact Hausdorff K; smallest closed norming boundary. Supremum convention includes empty K.

entries.title: Wiener Tauberian theorem
entries.scope: Real-line L1 translates and the Fourier-integral nonvanishing criterion. General LCA groups and the convolution-ideal adapter remain.

entries.title: Cohen–Hewitt factorization
entries.scope: Genuinely nonunital real or complex Banach algebras with a bounded directed left approximate identity acting strongly on the module. The essential-module characterization and norm control on the factor y remain.

entries.title: Atkinson theorem
entries.scope: Operators between real or complex Banach spaces, uniformly over RCLike scalars; no quotient Calkin algebra is introduced.

entries.title: Analytic Fredholm theorem
entries.scope: Invertibility at one point gives isolated exceptional parameters, analytic inverse elsewhere and genuine positive-order inverse poles with nonzero analytic regularizations. Finite-rank principal parts remain.

entries.title: Discrete spectrum of self-adjoint operators
entries.scope: The essential spectrum is explicitly the Fredholm essential spectrum; its compact-perturbation invariance is proved.

entries.title: Schatten Hölder inequality
entries.scope: Sharp constant-one finite real exponents p,q,r>=1, using TauCeti Schatten gauges on arbitrary Hilbert spaces. Infinite-exponent endpoints remain.

entries.title: Trace and cyclicity
entries.scope: Absolute convergence, basis independence, trace-norm bound and bounded-product cyclicity, with the actual upstream Schatten-one gauge.

entries.title: Wold decomposition
entries.scope: Isometries on complex Hilbert spaces; wandering coefficient space ker(V*), invariant-surjective unitary part, pairwise orthogonal forward wandering spaces and unconditional decompositions.

entries.title: Unitary dilation theorem
entries.scope: Minimal unitary power dilation and unique intertwining isometry for contractions; larger representation space bundled as ComplexHilbertSpace.

entries.title: Commutant lifting
entries.scope: Existence of the minimal co-invariant isometric dilation and the norm-preserving commuting coextension, expressed with actual adjoints and operator norms.

entries.title: First representation theorem
entries.scope: Densely defined complex sesquilinear form with explicit lower bound; completeness is in its form graph norm, not the ambient Hilbert norm. Unique self-adjoint representing partial map with matching lower bound.

entries.title: Friedrichs extension
entries.scope: Friedrichs existence/lower-bound clause for a densely defined semibounded symmetric operator; the canonical form completion and uniqueness characterization remain.

entries.title: KLMN theorem
entries.scope: Symmetric relative-form perturbation of a nonnegative closed form, relative bound 0<=a<1 and lower constant c>=0; same domain and explicit lower bound -c.

entries.title: Kato–Rellich theorem: cores
entries.scope: The self-adjointness corollary depends on the admitted core theorem and is not counted as proved.

entries.title: Analytic isolated eigenvalues
entries.scope: Bounded type-(A) families near zero, algebraically simple eigenpair specified by a rank-one reduced resolvent; actual holomorphic eigenvalue and eigenvector branches. Finite clusters, Riesz projections and unbounded type-(A)/(B) families remain.

entries.title: Birman–Schwinger principle
entries.scope: Bounded-operator kernel equivalence for a positive self-adjoint free operator and positive shift; the factor need not be compact or self-adjoint. The unbounded form setting and eigenvalue counting statements remain.

entries.title: RAGE theorem
entries.scope: Bounded self-adjoint generators: continuous-subspace compact-observation time averages and pure-point relative compactness of full unitary orbits. Unbounded generators remain.

entries.title: GNS cyclic vector and uniqueness
entries.scope: Uniqueness of cyclic realizations, including nonunital representations. Existence of the nonunital cyclic vector remains.

entries.title: Gelfand–Naimark theorem
entries.scope: Existence of a faithful isometric representation with closed range, for nonunital C*-algebras too; the universal sum-over-states construction remains.

entries.title: Bicommutant theorem
entries.scope: Unital star subalgebra, with explicit finite-vector and finite-matrix-coefficient neighborhood definitions of the strong and weak operator closures.

entries.title: Kaplansky density theorem
entries.scope: Possibly nonunital norm-closed star algebra acting nondegenerately; general and self-adjoint unit-ball strong density. Positive unit-ball version remains.

entries.title: Free central limit theorem
entries.scope: Normalized positive algebraic state and identically distributed free centered variance-one self-adjoint variables; convergence of all normalized-sum moments to explicit semicircle (Catalan) moments.

entries.title: R-transform linearization
entries.scope: Concrete triangular cumulant recursion, coefficient additivity for free variables, and R-transform series convergence/additivity on a common disk for bounded variables and a bounded normalized functional.

entries.title: Variation of constants
entries.scope: Uses pinned TauCeti C0 semigroups and generators; unique continuous integrated solution for L1 forcing and classical interior-time regularity for C1 forcing/domain initial data.

entries.title: Trotter–Kato approximation
entries.scope: One sufficiently large real resolvent parameter and a common exponential bound; equivalent uniform-on-bounded-time strong convergence.

entries.title: Chernoff product formula
entries.scope: Stable strongly continuous product family with tangency on an actual generator core; uniform convergence on bounded nonnegative time intervals.

entries.title: Analytic generation theorem
entries.scope: Closed densely defined partial operators, explicit spectral sectors/resolvent estimates, actual bounded operator-valued holomorphic extensions, and negative-generator sign convention.

entries.title: Balakrishnan formula
entries.scope: Actual normalized resolvent integral on D(B), integrability, and existence of its closed fractional-power graph. A full named fractional-power/domain calculus remains.

entries.title: Analytic spectral mapping
entries.scope: Eventually norm-continuous complex semigroups, with zero removed from the semigroup spectrum. An explicit analytic-extension-to-norm-continuity adapter remains.

entries.title: Gearhart–Prüss theorem
entries.scope: Bounded C0 semigroups on complex Hilbert spaces and the uniform imaginary-axis generator resolvent criterion.

entries.title: Arendt–Batty–Lyubich–Vũ theorem
entries.scope: Reflexive complex normed-space branch, with completeness derived from surjectivity of the bidual inclusion, countable imaginary-axis spectrum and no generator eigenvalues there. The general Banach-adjoint criterion remains.

entries.title: Crandall–Liggett generation
entries.scope: Concrete multivalued accretive graph and guarded resolvent; nonlinear contraction semigroup on the domain closure, Euler convergence there, and uniform time convergence on the actual domain.

entries.title: Hilbert–Schmidt kernels
entries.scope: Real or complex scalars. Sigma-finite measures with a supplied Hilbert basis; exact Hilbert-Schmidt energy and scalar-star adjoint kernel.

entries.title: Mercer theorem
entries.scope: Continuous positive-semidefinite kernel on compact Hausdorff D with finite full-support Borel measure; trace-class kernel operator, nonnegative eigenvalues, continuous normalized eigenfunctions, unconditional expansion and uniform absolute tails, including finite-rank/zero kernels.

entries.title: Volterra solvability
entries.scope: Existence and uniqueness for continuous triangular kernels. Successive-substitution convergence and continuous data dependence remain.

entries.title: Abel inversion
entries.scope: Real L1(0,T); all identities are a.e., and zero boundary values belong to the absolutely continuous representative. Complex extension remains available by components.

entries.title: Collectively compact approximation theorem
entries.scope: Strong collectively compact approximation on a real or complex Banach space.

entries.title: Failure of the critical $L^\infty$ embedding
entries.scope: Any nonempty open Euclidean domain, dimension at least two; essential unboundedness is stated by failure of MemLp at infinity.

entries.title: Quasicontinuity
entries.scope: Inhomogeneous C1,p capacity from smooth compact tests and open outer approximation; real weak first-order functions with finite p>1, including quasi-everywhere uniqueness.

entries.title: Fractional Hilbert identity
entries.scope: Extended square energies and their quantitative comparison, on L2; bundling the two Sobolev spaces is separate infrastructure.

entries.title: Bourgain–Brezis–Mironescu limit
entries.scope: Real scalar W1,p functions, all finite p>=1; exact constant expressed by a unit-ball moment, equivalent to the sphere constant by radial integration.

entries.title: Real interpolation theorem
entries.scope: Compatible Banach couples realized in their canonical normed sum, exact K-method gauge bound including q=infinity. The endpoint constants need no sign hypothesis. Gauge definitions remain in Interpolation.Basic. Bundled interpolation normed spaces, completeness, and construction from arbitrary compatible embeddings remain.

entries.title: Complex interpolation theorem
entries.scope: Calderon strip-function and gauge definitions and the exact bound. The endpoint constants need no sign hypothesis. Gauge definitions remain in Interpolation.Basic. Bundled normed spaces, completeness, and extension from arbitrary ambient embeddings remain.

entries.title: Hausdorff–Young inequality
entries.scope: Fourier-integral inequality on L1 ∩ Lp and failure above p=2 on Schwartz functions. Extension to a bounded Fourier map on all of Lp remains.

entries.title: Heisenberg uncertainty
entries.scope: Uncentered coordinate inequality with explicit L2 moment assumptions; centered versions and Gaussian equality classification remain.

entries.title: Fejér summation
entries.scope: One-dimensional probability circle: finite-p convergence, uniform convergence for continuous functions, and every lifted Lebesgue point. The product-kernel multidimensional interface remains.

entries.title: Carleson–Hunt theorem
entries.scope: Actual symmetric Fourier sums using Mathlib coefficients and circle characters; extended maximal pth-moment bound and almost-everywhere Fourier convergence for every 1<p<infinity.

entries.title: Hilbert transform as a principal-value integral
entries.scope: Concrete symmetric-distance truncations, principal-value limit, a.e. convergence for finite p>=1, identification with the -i sign multiplier on L2, and actual weak (1,1) control.

entries.title: Weighted maximal theorem
entries.scope: Ball-based A_p and A_1 characteristics, positive locally integrable weights, weighted Haar densities, and TauCeti centered maximal function. Ball/cube classes are mathematically equivalent, but an explicit cube-comparison adapter remains.

entries.title: The modular homomorphism
entries.scope: Continuity for locally compact Hausdorff groups; the inversion measure identity currently assumes second countability. General Haar inversion and explicit integral adapters remain.

entries.title: Pontryagin duality
entries.scope: General locally compact Hausdorff abelian groups; evaluation formula specifies the topological double-dual equivalence using Mathlib compact-open duals.

entries.title: Plancherel theorem
entries.scope: Second-countable LCA groups, normalized dual Haar measure, a Plancherel isometry equivalence with the L1 Fourier integral on L1∩L2, and Hausdorff-Young bounds on L1∩Lp. General non-sigma-compact groups and bundled all-Lp extensions remain.

entries.title: Amenability and invariant means
entries.scope: Actual positive normalized bounded functionals on Haar L-infinity, a.e.-intrinsic left invariance, compact and abelian amenability, and closed-subgroup inheritance. Extension permanence and comparison to other amenability models remain.

entries.title: Frame operator criterion
entries.scope: Concrete coefficient energies, Bessel/frame predicates, analysis criterion and synthesis-surjectivity criterion. The explicit operator-order equivalence remains.

entries.title: Canonical dual reconstruction
entries.scope: Reciprocal reversed bounds and both unconditional expansions; optimality of those bounds is not stated.

entries.title: Density obstruction
entries.scope: Rectangular one-dimensional single-window Gabor families: frame and Riesz-sequence density bounds and the critical-density basis corollary. Higher dimensions remain. The corollary inherits admitted dependencies.

entries.title: Balian–Low theorem
entries.scope: L2 Gabor Riesz bases, concrete time-frequency translates, and the incompatibility of finite second moments on both the window and its L2 Fourier transform.

entries.title: Shannon sampling theorem
entries.scope: Inverse-integral representatives formed by restricting arbitrary L2 frequency data to [-B,B], B>0, with normalized sinc. Outside-band data are irrelevant to these representative-only conclusions.

entries.title: Kadec's one-quarter theorem
entries.scope: Equivalent normalized exponential Riesz basis on the frequency interval, a uniform perturbation bound strictly below one quarter, and a sharpness counterexample for every larger threshold.

entries.title: Landau's necessary densities
entries.scope: Uniformly separated sample sets, extended lower/upper Beurling densities, and stable sampling/interpolation for inverse-integral bandlimited representatives.

entries.title: Stable recovery from restricted isometry
entries.scope: Concrete finite-coordinate l1 norms, sparsity, best sparse error and basis-pursuit minimizers. Uniform constants depend only on an admissible delta_(2s)<sqrt(2)-1; positive sparsity and nonnegative noise are explicit.

entries.title: Calderón–Vaillancourt theorem
entries.scope: Finite-derivative L2 estimate on the dense Schwartz class for actual physical-convention left quantization. A bundled extension to all L2 inputs remains.

entries.title: Sobolev mapping theorem
entries.scope: Global S1,0 symbol class and quantitative Sobolev energy estimate on Schwartz functions. Bounded completed-space maps and properly supported local interfaces remain.

entries.title: Sharp Gårding inequality
entries.scope: Nonnegative real scalar global S1,0 symbols and the sharp (m-1)/2 Sobolev-order lower bound on Schwartz inputs; physical exp(ix dot xi) normalization.

entries.title: Floquet theorem
entries.scope: Normalized fundamental operator curves for finite-dimensional real/complex spaces; complex period T and real period 2T factorizations with invertible C1 periodic factors.

entries.title: Sturm separation and comparison
entries.scope: Classical regular interval equations with positive leading coefficient, positive weight for spectral comparison, consecutive lower-mode zeros, and a Wronskian independence test for separation.

entries.title: Lyapunov's direct theorem
entries.scope: Local stability and attraction for an existing global flow. The strict criterion assumes continuity of the vector field. Local ODE construction, continuation and proper global variants remain.

entries.title: LaSalle invariance principle
entries.scope: A compact positively invariant subset of an existing global flow, with no finite-rest-set assumption.

entries.title: Poincaré–Bendixson theorem
entries.scope: Existing global C1 planar flow with an orbit in a compact forward absorbing set; no equilibrium in its omega-limit set, which is identified with a whole periodic orbit.

entries.title: Wave Cauchy problem in energy spaces
entries.scope: Actual TauCeti W1,2 position states and L2 velocities, continuous on a compact time interval; positive wave speed, L1-in-time L2 forcing, integrated weak velocity equation, and unique time-interval curves.

entries.title: Finite propagation speed
entries.scope: Two energy solutions whose initial positions agree a.e. on a ball, whose initial velocities agree there, and whose forcing agrees in the backward shrinking cone have agreeing position components, as TauCeti W1p values, a.e. on later shrinking balls.

entries.title: Higher integrability of the gradient
entries.scope: Actual W1,2 weak gradients and bounded measurable uniformly elliptic divergence coefficients; homogeneous and divergence-forcing local Meyers estimate on concentric unit/two balls.

entries.title: Alexandrov–Bakelman–Pucci estimate
entries.scope: Classical C2-in-domain, continuous-up-to-boundary ABP inequality on bounded domains with extended source norm; the W2,n strong-solution interface remains.

entries.title: Krylov–Safonov theorem
entries.scope: Uniform Harnack and interior Holder estimates for classical C2 solutions with merely measurable uniformly elliptic coefficients. The general strong-solution formulation remains.

entries.title: Interior Schauder estimate
entries.scope: Localized C2,alpha a priori gauge estimate for general Holder coefficients including drift and zeroth order terms, with explicit coefficient-gauge finiteness.

entries.title: Interior $W^{2,p}$ estimates
entries.scope: Classical a priori interior Hessian Lp bound with continuous leading and bounded measurable lower coefficients. The full strong W2,p realization remains.

entries.title: Comparison and uniqueness
entries.scope: Actual semicontinuous upper/lower contact definitions; comparison for gamma u+G0(Du,D2u)=f on bounded domains with gamma>0 and autonomous continuous degenerate elliptic G0.

entries.title: Evans–Krylov theorem
entries.scope: Actual viscosity solutions of a convex or concave uniformly elliptic Hessian equation; C2,beta interior regularity and quantitative gauge estimate with Holder forcing.

entries.title: $p$-harmonic regularity
entries.scope: Actual W1,p weak p-harmonicity at finite p>1, locally C1,alpha representatives and a nonnegative Harnack estimate on concentric balls.

entries.title: Kružkov existence and uniqueness
entries.scope: Concrete entropy inequalities with initial trace term, bounded existence, maximum principle, L1-local trace, and spacetime-a.e. uniqueness. Local finite-speed stability remains.

entries.title: Hopf–Lax formula
entries.scope: Concrete extended Legendre transform and Hopf-Lax infimum, finiteness, first-order viscosity solution and initial attainment for superlinear convex Hamiltonians. Spatial derivative/entropy bridge remains.

entries.title: Homogeneous Strichartz estimate
entries.scope: All admissible exponent pairs including infinity and the forbidden-endpoint exclusion; global mixed-norm estimate for the actual free Fourier evolution of Schwartz data. L2 operator extension remains.

entries.title: Virial blowup criterion
entries.scope: Exact focusing virial identity for jointly C3 Schwartz slices with locally uniform rapid derivative decay. Energy-class finite-variance approximation and finite-time breakdown conclusion remain.

entries.title: Leray–Hopf existence
entries.scope: Global Euclidean three-dimensional existence with actual L2 velocity curves, distributional incompressibility/momentum, weak spatial derivatives, finite dissipation, weak continuity and energy inequalities. Torus variant remains.

entries.title: Two-dimensional viscous uniqueness
entries.scope: Global Euclidean two-dimensional energy-class existence and uniqueness of the nonnegative-time velocity curve; gradient representatives are existential a.e. data. Positive-time smoothness interface remains.

entries.title: Boltzmann's $H$ theorem
entries.scope: Hard-sphere collision operator and exact negative entropy-production identity for positive measurable densities under explicit four-log absolute integrability, with probability-normalized angular measure. Zero-density extension and spatial transport entropy remain.

entries.title: Newton–Kantorovich convergence
entries.scope: Real or complex scalars. Concrete totalized Newton iteration, majorant-radius convergence including the L=0 limiting radius, and local quadratic convergence. The initial step is controlled by a norm bound. A separate affine one-step corollary is not stated.

entries.title: Schauder fixed-point theorem
entries.scope: Nonempty closed convex subset of a Banach space and continuous self-map with relatively compact total image; the domain may be unbounded.

entries.title: Kakutani–Fan–Glicksberg theorem
entries.scope: Upper-hemicontinuous multifunction on a nonempty compact convex set in a locally convex Hausdorff space, with nonempty closed convex values in that set.

entries.title: Browder–Göhde–Kirk theorem
entries.scope: Nonempty closed bounded convex subset of a uniformly convex real Banach space; no compactness of the map.

entries.title: Minty's range theorem
entries.scope: Hilbert graphs and positive-scale resolvent fibers; one/every scale equivalence. Fiber uniqueness from monotonicity is proved independently; the existence corollary depends on the admitted Minty theorem.

entries.title: Browder–Minty surjectivity
entries.scope: Bounded-on-bounded, hemicontinuous monotone dual-valued map on a reflexive real Banach space, with coercivity in the dual pairing; strict-monotonicity injectivity is proved.

entries.title: Existence for variational inequalities
entries.scope: Both bounded closed convex and unbounded coercive variants in reflexive real Banach spaces; explicit forcing and basepoint-relative coercivity.

entries.title: Euler–Lagrange equation
entries.scope: Proved conditional weak first variation: local minimality plus a justified derivative-of-action identity. Derivation from growth bounds and the classical Euler-Lagrange PDE remain.

entries.title: Mountain-pass theorem
entries.scope: Concrete continuous path class and real minimax level; C1 Banach functional with the Palais-Smale condition only at that level.

entries.title: Frostman's lemma
entries.scope: Positive Hausdorff measure on a compact Euclidean set, at a strictly positive exponent, iff there is a supported Frostman probability. This positivity is mathematically equivalent to positive Hausdorff content; a separate content definition and explicit dimension corollary remain.

entries.title: Projection dimension theorem
entries.scope: Planar Borel sets and angular projections to a line, including positive projected length above dimension one. Higher-dimensional Grassmannian formulations remain.

entries.title: Besicovitch–Federer projection theorem
entries.scope: Planar Borel sets of finite one-dimensional Hausdorff measure; pure unrectifiability is tested on actual Lipschitz curves, and projected length vanishes almost everywhere. Higher dimensions remain.

entries.title: BV compactness
entries.scope: Whole-space BV families supported in a fixed compact set, uniform L1-plus-variation bound, strong L1 subsequence convergence, and lower semicontinuity. Uses TauCeti variation. The global bounded-Lipschitz-domain extension/compactness interface remains.

entries.title: Coarea for BV
entries.scope: Scalar measurable BV functions on any Euclidean open set, actual TauCeti total variation and perimeter, and the extended integral over superlevel sets.

entries.title: Equilibrium measure
entries.scope: Variational compact and outer Newtonian capacities, positive potentials and energies retaining infinity at the kernel pole; unique equilibrium charge for compact sets including zero capacity, in dimension at least three.

entries.title: Choquet properties
entries.scope: Monotonicity is proved; continuity below, compact continuity above, countable subadditivity and Borel capacitability are targets. The stronger analytic-set capacitability clause is not stated.

entries.title: Perron–Wiener resolutivity
entries.scope: Lower/upper Perron equality and unique probability harmonic-measure representation on bounded open Euclidean sets of dimension at least two, allowing disconnected sets and irregular boundary. Null-set independence from the pole remains unstated.

entries.title: Wiener's criterion
entries.scope: Bounded open Euclidean sets in dimension at least three, without connectedness; boundary regularity is actual Perron attainment, with concrete annular pieces and divergent capacity series.

entries.title: Self-similar attractors
entries.scope: Nonempty complete metric ambient space and finite contractions; the compact attractor uses a nonempty family. Invariant probabilities allow nonnegative weights summing to one, including zeros, and uniqueness is among all invariant Borel probabilities.

entries.title: Laurent expansion
entries.scope: Finite-radius annuli with nonnegative inner radius. A direct infinite-outer-radius interface remains.

entries.title: Great Picard theorem
entries.scope: Holomorphic punctured-disk Great Picard, every finite value infinitely often with at most one exception. The meromorphic spherical two-exception version remains.

entries.title: Runge approximation on compact sets
entries.scope: Prescribed finite poles meet every bounded complementary component; infinity is always permitted through a polynomial part. The formulation where infinity is forbidden remains.

entries.title: Mittag–Leffler theorem
entries.scope: Arbitrary compact-locally-finite pole data on a nonempty connected plane domain; principal parts are finite reciprocal-coordinate polynomials with zero constant term. Identities use analytic germs on punctured neighborhoods.

entries.title: Weierstrass zero theorem
entries.scope: Exact zero sets and prescribed positive analytic orders on locally finite data in a plane domain.

entries.title: Hadamard factorization
entries.scope: Nonzero entire functions of finite real growth order; fixed genus and polynomial degree bounded by the order, an optional zero list allowing finite lists, explicit summability and locally uniform product convergence.

entries.title: Cartwright zero distribution
entries.scope: Exponential-type Cartwright functions, multiplicity counting and real-axis-sector concentration. Extended logarithms retain negative infinity at zeros in the indicator.

entries.title: Logarithmic derivative lemma
entries.scope: Every fixed positive derivative order for entire nonconstant functions, using Mathlib Nevanlinna proximity/characteristic and a finite-linear-measure exceptional set. General meromorphic functions and finite-order O(log r) sharpening remain.

entries.title: Five-value theorem
entries.scope: Nonconstant entire functions sharing four distinct finite preimage sets; their common omitted spherical value infinity gives the fifth shared value. The general meromorphic theorem and pole fibers remain.

entries.title: Hardy boundary realization beyond radial $H^2$ convergence
entries.scope: Concrete analytic Hardy gauges with normalized angular measure; finite positive p have nontangential limits, exact norm and radial Lp convergence. Infinity has nontangential limits and its norm identity, without a false L-infinity radial-convergence assertion.

entries.title: Canonical factorization
entries.scope: Canonical factorization existence with actual Blaschke products, finite singular angular measures, outer integrals, and a unimodular phase. Uniqueness up to the appropriate phases remains.

entries.title: Carleson embedding theorem
entries.scope: Finite measures supported in the disk, explicit normalized-arc Carleson boxes, and every positive finite Hardy exponent.

entries.title: Carleson interpolation theorem
entries.scope: Distinct disk sequences; separation products are infima of finite nonnegative products, avoiding arbitrary infinite-product junk values. Interpolation uses a common norm bound for data of sup norm at most one.

entries.title: Nevanlinna–Pick theorem
entries.scope: Complex positive-semidefinite Pick matrices; arbitrary finite data, including the empty index type and target values on the unit circle.

entries.title: Corona theorem
entries.scope: Nonempty finite families with uniform bound M and positive corona lower bound delta; solution bounds depend only on n, delta and M.

entries.title: Bergman kernel
entries.scope: Normalized weighted measure, principal-power kernel, reproduction, monomial norms and closed holomorphic L2 carrier. Orthonormal-basis and coefficient-completeness interfaces remain.

entries.title: Bergman projection
entries.scope: L2 orthogonal projection with integral kernel and all-p boundedness estimate targets. The all-p analytic range/surjectivity interface remains. The all-p estimate is not a GAPS_EASY consequence.

entries.title: Fock sampling density
entries.scope: Entire Gaussian-square-integrable functions; uniformly separated planar node sets, extended counting and lower uniform density, with the sharp strict sampling threshold alpha/pi.

entries.title: Grönwall area theorem
entries.scope: Exterior schlicht functions normalized at infinity, actual contour-defined Laurent coefficients, nonnegative coefficient energy and the omitted Lebesgue area.

entries.title: Koebe quarter theorem
entries.scope: Normalized analytic schlicht functions on the disk; sharpness witnessed by the explicit Koebe function.

entries.title: de Branges's theorem
entries.scope: Every coefficient n>=2 and rigidity at any equality coefficient, with equality to a Koebe rotation on the disk.

entries.title: Loewner–Kufarev equation
entries.scope: Concrete radial chains with nested images and local time absolute continuity uniform on compact subdisks; a measurable normalized Herglotz field and a common almost-everywhere time set.

entries.title: Nehari sufficient bound
entries.scope: Locally univalent holomorphic disk functions and the exact Schwarzian bound two. The meromorphic spherical formulation remains.

entries.title: Measurable Riemann mapping theorem
entries.scope: Weak W^(1,2)-local Beltrami solutions among plane homeomorphisms, normalized at zero and one; a plane homeomorphism fixes infinity on one-point compactification. The quasiconformal constant is (1+k)/(1-k).

entries.title: Astala area distortion
entries.scope: Disk self-maps fixing zero that are restrictions of plane homeomorphisms, with the 1/K area exponent. Exponent optimality and a standalone disk-homeomorphism API remain.

entries.title: Hartogs separate analyticity
entries.scope: Separate coordinate holomorphy on open subsets of finite complex coordinate spaces, without assumed continuity; includes zero-dimensional spaces.

entries.title: Polydisk Taylor expansion and estimates
entries.scope: Unequal-polyradius normal series, contour coefficients, coefficient Cauchy estimates and Weierstrass theorem. The mixed-derivative/coefficient identity remains.

entries.title: Hartogs extension
entries.scope: Compact holes in connected domains of dimension at least two, with connected complement. Uniqueness is equality on the domain rather than equality of arbitrary global extensions.

entries.title: Weierstrass preparation
entries.scope: Convergent complex germs on a product of base coordinates and one final coordinate, finite final-coordinate order, monic distinguished polynomial and holomorphic unit. Uniqueness is germ equality; degree zero is allowed.

entries.title: Weierstrass division
entries.scope: Analytic quotient and polynomial remainder germs for concrete distinguished coefficients, with unique germ data and degree-zero edge case.

entries.title: Oka–Weil approximation
entries.scope: Polynomially convex compact subsets of affine C^n, actual multivariate polynomial hulls and polynomial approximants. General Stein manifolds remain.

entries.title: Repelling cycles are dense
entries.scope: Polynomial maps of degree at least two, with Julia set defined as the boundary of the bounded-orbit filled set. General rational maps and the normal-family identification remain.

entries.title: Koenigs linearization
entries.scope: Coordinates are germs of analytic maps at a fixed point; uniqueness is eventual equality, with nonzero multiplier of norm different from one.

entries.title: Böttcher's theorem
entries.scope: Exact order is expressed by f=z^k*g near zero, with g analytic and g(0) nonzero; the prescribed derivative c satisfies c^(k-1)=g(0).

entries.title: Connectedness criterion
entries.scope: Filled and boundary Julia connectedness and boundedness of all finite critical orbits. Actual orbit, escape-rate and filled-set definitions and supporting targets are included.

entries.title: Mandelbrot connectedness
entries.scope: Quadratic critical-orbit definition, compactness, connectedness, closed radius-two escape bound and equivalence with Julia connectedness.

entries.title: Eremenko escaping theorem
entries.scope: Transcendental entire maps: nonempty escaping set and unboundedness of every connected component of its closure. The boundary-equals-nonnormality-Julia assertion remains.

entries.title: Chebyshev alternation theorem
entries.scope: Uniform polynomial approximation on [-1,1], including existence/uniqueness and alternation; the generalized Haar-space criterion remains.

entries.title: Müntz–Szász theorem
entries.scope: Real continuous functions on [0,1]; the span includes one and positive real powers. The reciprocal divergence is expressed as nonsummability.

entries.title: Korovkin theorem
entries.scope: Real continuous functions on [0,1]; the complex-linear extension by components is not separately stated.

entries.title: Jackson's trigonometric theorem
entries.scope: Concrete angular trigonometric polynomials, extended Lp errors and moduli for 1<=p<=infinity; this interface assumes continuous periodic representatives even at finite p. Extension to all periodic Lp classes remains.

entries.title: Inverse trigonometric estimate
entries.scope: Inverse smoothness estimate with constants uniform in 1<=p<=infinity, currently on continuous periodic functions. The general finite-p Lp interface remains.

entries.title: Bernstein derivative inequality
entries.scope: All derivative orders and degrees, including constants and order zero, with period 2*pi and angular frequencies exp(ikx).

entries.title: Markov inequality
entries.scope: Full [-1,1] bound including interior points, plus attainment of the n^2 constant.

entries.title: Chebyshev interpolation stability
entries.scope: Chebyshev-extrema Lebesgue constants and the general Lebesgue near-best interpolation inequality; log(n+1) includes degree zero.

entries.title: Newman's theorem
entries.scope: Pole-free real type-(n,n) rational approximation to abs(x), with two-sided root-exponential rates and the corresponding polynomial rate 1/n.

entries.title: Favard's theorem
entries.scope: Actual monic Jacobi recurrence and existence of a probability orthogonality measure with infinite support and all finite moments. The separate assertion that coefficients and total mass determine every moment remains.

entries.title: Gauss quadrature
entries.scope: Positive unique weights at prescribed distinct roots, exactness and Christoffel formula; uniqueness with varying nodes up to permutation remains.

entries.title: Hamburger theorem
entries.scope: All finite Hankel matrices are positive semidefinite iff a finite positive Borel measure represents every real moment. Zero mass is included.

entries.title: Stieltjes theorem
entries.scope: Both unshifted and once-shifted Hankel positivity, with support on [0,infinity).

entries.title: Hausdorff theorem
entries.scope: Finite measures, including mass zero; concrete forward differences, Bernstein weights and discrete approximants.

entries.title: Moment Carleman criteria
entries.scope: Extended-real Carleman sums include zero moments via infinite inverse powers. Uniqueness is among existing representing measures, on the correct support.

entries.title: Gamma multiplication beyond duplication
entries.scope: Complex Gamma multiplication for every positive integer multiplier, away from poles; the explicit global meromorphic-continuation identity remains.

entries.title: Gauss equation
entries.scope: Denominator parameter avoids nonpositive integers; regular singularity allows removable/ordinary degenerate cases.

entries.title: Second solution
entries.scope: Concrete connection formula, totalized order-limit at integers, incoming/outgoing Hankel functions and principal-slit-plane ODE/Wronskian targets. The noninteger formula is proved.

entries.title: Airy representation
entries.scope: Actual normalized Airy power series and truncated oscillatory real-axis integral. The improper integral is a limit, rather than a totalized Bochner integral on the half-line.

entries.title: Mittag–Leffler entire functions
entries.scope: Concrete series, convergence, entireness and E_(1,1)=exp for positive real alpha and complex beta. The exact entire-function order 1/alpha remains.

entries.title: Borel–Ritt theorem
entries.scope: Concrete rotated sectors and uniform all-order power remainders on every closed proper subsector, for opening strictly between zero and 2*pi.

entries.title: Watson's lemma
entries.scope: Finite-order and full complex-amplitude Laplace expansions for positive real alpha, with explicit local integrability and exponential tail bounds. Complex alpha with positive real part remains.

entries.title: Interior Laplace minimum
entries.scope: Leading one-dimensional interior-minimum Laplace asymptotic on a finite interval, with phase C2 only on that interval. A scaled limit permits zero amplitude at the minimum; higher coefficients and remainder expansions remain.

entries.title: Euler–Maclaurin formula
entries.scope: Positive truncation order p; globally C^(2p) real functions; integer endpoints m ≤ n, including equality. The displayed remainder is false at p=0, which is excluded.

entries.title: Karamata Tauberian theorem
entries.scope: Locally finite positive measures supported on the nonnegative half-line, all positive Laplace transforms integrable, and measurable slowly varying functions. Includes rho=0.

entries.title: Borel–Laplace theorem
entries.scope: Actual formal Borel series, directional Laplace integral, analytic continuation of opening β with exponential growth, uniform Gevrey-one estimates, and a holomorphic sum on the sector of opening π+β. Agreement with the original ray holds on the convergence sector of opening π.

entries.title: Analytic isomonodromy for the Schlesinger system
Positive mass theorem in dimension three

batches.description: Expansion into fine differentiation, probability limits, rough paths, ergodic theory, Banach geometry, ordered spaces, convex/nonlinear analysis, capacity, approximation, moments and asymptotics.
Further expansion into operator algebras and semigroups, harmonic analysis and sampling, Sobolev/PDE/microlocal analysis, geometric measure theory, complex analysis and complex dynamics.
